title: The Conflict Between Amos and the Priest Amaziah
description: Amaziah, the priest at Bethel, accuses Amos before King Jeroboam and orders him to flee to Judah and stop prophesying at the king's sanctuary. Amos replies that he is not a professional prophet but a shepherd whom the Lord has called, and he proclaims severe judgment against Amaziah's family and over Israel, which will be taken into exile.
